name: Darius Vogel
original_name: ダリウス・フォーゲル
source:
He might take the form of a pure angel, but the head of Vogel is a man to be wary of. 

With his gentle smile and sweet voice, he has an uncanny talent for bewitching others. 

Beneath his flawless facade, he hides his ambitions and his true reasons for approaching Crown... and you.

Organization: Vogel
Fairy Tale Curse: Swan Lake's Sorcerer

[Official English in-game introduction]
